CUSTOM_BAR_PSI_CONVERSION.name: Pressure in bar must include its p.s.i. conversion
CUSTOM_BAR_PSI_CONVERSION.description: Every pressure expressed in bar must be followed in parentheses by its numeric conversion in p.s.i.

CUSTOM_CHAPTER_NUMBER_SEQUENCE.name: Sequential chapter numbering
CUSTOM_CHAPTER_NUMBER_SEQUENCE.description: Within each chapter page series, numbered headings such as 1., 2., 3., etc. must follow in order without gaps or reversals.

CUSTOM_CMM_MAPPING_SUSPECT.name: Verify the CMM number entered in the mapping
CUSTOM_CMM_MAPPING_SUSPECT.description: Warns when the same CMM number, different from the mapping, is detected in at least 90% of usable footers.

CUSTOM_CMM_NUMBER.name: CMM number matches the document context
CUSTOM_CMM_NUMBER.description: The ATA/CMM number in the footer must match meta_cmm_number in the document context. This check validates the value; a separate rule checks the 23 pt font size.

CUSTOM_CMM_NUMBER_FONT_SIZE.name: CMM number font size (ATA)
CUSTOM_CMM_NUMBER_FONT_SIZE.description: The CMM number (ATA) in the footer must use a 23 pt font.

CUSTOM_COPYRIGHT_POSITION.name: Copyright position based on page parity
CUSTOM_COPYRIGHT_POSITION.description: On every PDF page, the upper-left corner of the THALES copyright must be at x=3.03 cm on odd pages and x=1.76 cm on even pages, with y=26.51 cm. Tolerance is 0.10 cm.

CUSTOM_DECIMAL_COMMA.name: Decimal values must use a point separator
CUSTOM_DECIMAL_COMMA.description: Decimal numeric values on modified pages must use a point rather than a comma as the decimal separator.

CUSTOM_ENUMERATION_PUNCTUATION_SWAP.name: Comma and period swapped in enumerations
CUSTOM_ENUMERATION_PUNCTUATION_SWAP.description: On modified pages, informationally flags a full stop instead of a comma on an intermediate enumeration item, or a comma instead of the final full stop.

CUSTOM_FOOTER_PAGE_NUMBER.name: Page number present and consistent in the footer
CUSTOM_FOOTER_PAGE_NUMBER.description: Every page must show one page number in the footer, not a combined label such as Page 25/26. LEP, ROR, Highlights, and Title Page pages are checked against their expected prefix and order.

CUSTOM_FORBIDDEN_CONSUMABLES.name: Consumables to remove
CUSTOM_FORBIDDEN_CONSUMABLES.description: References to forbidden consumables must be removed.

CUSTOM_HEADER_DOCUMENT_TYPE.name: Document type in headers outside TP1
CUSTOM_HEADER_DOCUMENT_TYPE.description: Every non-TP1 header must contain an allowed document type: OVERHAUL MANUAL, MAINTENANCE MANUAL, COMPONENT MAINTENANCE MANUAL, ABBREVIATED COMPONENT MAINTENANCE MANUAL, OPERATING MANUAL, ILLUSTRATED PARTS CATALOG, COMPONENT MAINTENANCE PARTS LIST, or OPERATING MANUAL PARTS LIST.

CUSTOM_HIGHLIGHTS_ATA_NUMBER.name: ATA number on the first Highlights page
CUSTOM_HIGHLIGHTS_ATA_NUMBER.description: The first Highlights page must contain the ATA number matching the document CMM number in the mapping.

CUSTOM_HIGHLIGHTS_CHAPTER.name: Allowed chapter heading in Highlights
CUSTOM_HIGHLIGHTS_CHAPTER.description: Every chapter or section in Highlights must use one of the chapter titles authorized by the THALES catalog.

CUSTOM_HIGHLIGHTS_DELETION_DESCRIPTION.name: Description required for deleted items in Highlights
CUSTOM_HIGHLIGHTS_DELETION_DESCRIPTION.description: Every D row in Highlights must have 'Chapter deleted' or 'Page deleted' in its description.

CUSTOM_HIGHLIGHTS_DESIGNATION_REQUIRED.name: Designation required for each Highlights page entry
CUSTOM_HIGHLIGHTS_DESIGNATION_REQUIRED.description: Every Highlights row containing a page range must have an R, N, U, or D designation.

CUSTOM_HIGHLIGHTS_DOCUMENT_TYPE.name: Document type above the ATA number in Highlights
CUSTOM_HIGHLIGHTS_DOCUMENT_TYPE.description: The first Highlights page must show an allowed document type above the ATA number: OVERHAUL MANUAL, MAINTENANCE MANUAL, COMPONENT MAINTENANCE MANUAL, ABBREVIATED COMPONENT MAINTENANCE MANUAL, OPERATING MANUAL, ILLUSTRATED PARTS CATALOG, COMPONENT MAINTENANCE PARTS LIST, or OPERATING MANUAL PARTS LIST.

CUSTOM_HIGHLIGHTS_HOLDER.name: Highlights recipient matches the TP1 title
CUSTOM_HIGHLIGHTS_HOLDER.description: The first Highlights page must start with 'TO: HOLDER OF <title>', where <title> matches the bold title on the TP1 page.

CUSTOM_HIGHLIGHTS_LEGEND_FOOTER.name: Highlights legend immediately before the footer
CUSTOM_HIGHLIGHTS_LEGEND_FOOTER.description: On every Highlights page, the table and its legend (N: New - D: Deleted ...) must end immediately before the footer, with no intervening text line.

CUSTOM_HIGHLIGHTS_PAGE_LABEL_FORMAT.name: Page/Pages label and alignment in Highlights
CUSTOM_HIGHLIGHTS_PAGE_LABEL_FORMAT.description: A page range is written as 'Pages 701 to 704' and a single page as 'Page  401', with two spaces to preserve number alignment.

CUSTOM_HIGHLIGHTS_PAGE_PAIRING.name: Highlights pages declared as odd/even pairs
CUSTOM_HIGHLIGHTS_PAGE_PAIRING.description: Highlights declare pages in pairs: an odd page is followed by its corresponding even page, and an even page is preceded by its odd page.

CUSTOM_HIGHLIGHTS_PNR_HEADER.name: PNR number present and correct in the page header
CUSTOM_HIGHLIGHTS_PNR_HEADER.description: The header of every Highlights page must contain all PNR numbers in the document mapping.

CUSTOM_HIGHLIGHTS_REVISED_DESCRIPTION.name: Description required for R rows in Highlights
CUSTOM_HIGHLIGHTS_REVISED_DESCRIPTION.description: Every R row in Highlights must have a description, except that Illustrated Parts List may use the description on its section row.

CUSTOM_HIGHLIGHTS_REVISION_HEADER.name: Revision header above the Highlights table
CUSTOM_HIGHLIGHTS_REVISION_HEADER.description: The page whose name contains Highlights must show the REVISION No. header with the mapped number and date above the table.

CUSTOM_INTRODUCTION_SHOP_VERIFICATION.name: Shop Verification matches the mapped manufacturer
CUSTOM_INTRODUCTION_SHOP_VERIFICATION.description: The INTRODUCTION page must contain the expected Shop Verification block for the manufacturer selected in the mapping.

CUSTOM_LETTER_DIGIT_CONFUSION.name: Confusion between letters and digits
CUSTOM_LETTER_DIGIT_CONFUSION.description: Flags a digit used in a word in place of a letter, and O, I, or l used in a numeric sequence.

CUSTOM_LIST_OF_MATERIALS_CODE_LOWERCASE.name: LIST OF MATERIALS codes in lowercase
CUSTOM_LIST_OF_MATERIALS_CODE_LOWERCASE.description: Uppercase letters are not allowed in the CODE column of the LIST OF MATERIALS table.

CUSTOM_LIST_OF_MATERIALS_CODE_NO_PARENTH.name: LIST OF MATERIALS code without parentheses
CUSTOM_LIST_OF_MATERIALS_CODE_NO_PARENTH.description: The CODE column in the LIST OF MATERIALS table must not contain parentheses. Parentheses in other columns are not checked.

CUSTOM_LIST_OF_MATERIALS_SUPPLIER_FSCM.name: FSCM number required in the supplier column
CUSTOM_LIST_OF_MATERIALS_SUPPLIER_FSCM.description: In the SUPPLIERS TRADE NAME AND CODE FSCM column of the LIST OF MATERIALS, each supplier name must be followed by a five-character FSCM number in parentheses: (FSCM XXXXX).

CUSTOM_METRIC_LENGTH_INCH_CONVERSION.name: Metric length converted to inches
CUSTOM_METRIC_LENGTH_INCH_CONVERSION.description: Every length expressed in mm, cm, m, or km must be followed by its numeric conversion in inches in parentheses.

CUSTOM_METRIC_MASS_LBF_CONVERSION.name: Metric mass converted to lb
CUSTOM_METRIC_MASS_LBF_CONVERSION.description: Every mass expressed in mg, g, kg, or tonnes must be followed by its numeric conversion in lb in parentheses.

CUSTOM_METRIC_TORQUE_LBF_IN_CONVERSION.name: Metric torque converted to lbf.in
CUSTOM_METRIC_TORQUE_LBF_IN_CONVERSION.description: Every torque expressed in N.m, daN.m, or kN.m must be followed by its numeric conversion in lbf.in in parentheses.

CUSTOM_NI_PART_NUMBER_ORDER.name: Numerical Index sorted by Part Number
CUSTOM_NI_PART_NUMBER_ORDER.description: Alphanumeric values in the Numerical Index Part Number column must be in case-insensitive lexicographic order, including across consecutive pages. Letter-prefixed values precede digit-prefixed values.

CUSTOM_NO_DEGREE_C_SYMBOL.name: Temperature unit C written as deg. C
CUSTOM_NO_DEGREE_C_SYMBOL.description: The °C symbol must be written as deg. C.

CUSTOM_NO_DEGREE_F_SYMBOL.name: Temperature unit F written as deg. F
CUSTOM_NO_DEGREE_F_SYMBOL.description: The °F symbol must be written as deg. F.

CUSTOM_PAGE_CONTENT_POSITION.name: Content position based on page parity
CUSTOM_PAGE_CONTENT_POSITION.description: On every PDF page, the median left margin of the content (excluding the copyright line) must be x=3.03 cm on odd pages and x=1.76 cm on even pages. Tolerance is 0.10 cm.

CUSTOM_PARAGRAPH_JUSTIFICATION.name: Body paragraphs justified on modified pages
CUSTOM_PARAGRAPH_JUSTIFICATION.description: On modified pages, multiline body paragraphs must be visually aligned on both the left and right, except for the final line. Alignment is estimated from PDF geometry and may be inconclusive for short paragraphs or pages without a text layer.

CUSTOM_PASCAL_INHG_CONVERSION.name: Pressure in pascals converted to inHg
CUSTOM_PASCAL_INHG_CONVERSION.description: Every pressure expressed in Pa, hPa, kPa, MPa, or GPa must be followed by its numeric conversion in inHg in parentheses.

CUSTOM_PDF_BOOKMARK_TITLE_MATCH.name: PDF bookmark title shown on its target page
CUSTOM_PDF_BOOKMARK_TITLE_MATCH.description: The title of each PDF bookmark must appear in the text of its destination page.

CUSTOM_PNR_PAGE_VALUE.name: PNR number in the page matches the mapping
CUSTOM_PNR_PAGE_VALUE.description: The number after 'PNR:' on a Highlights page must match the document mapping.

CUSTOM_REPAIR_NOTE.name: Required introduction and categories in REPAIR notes
CUSTOM_REPAIR_NOTE.description: Each REPAIR page must start its NOTE with the expected operational introduction and contain the Pressure and Relative humidity categories with their reference values.

CUSTOM_REPLACE_LEGACY_NAMES.name: Legacy company names replaced with THALES
CUSTOM_REPLACE_LEGACY_NAMES.description: References to AVIONICS, SEXTANT, and THOMSON must be replaced with THALES.

CUSTOM_REVISION_BAR_MARGIN_POSITION.name: Revision bar position relative to the margin
CUSTOM_REVISION_BAR_MARGIN_POSITION.description: On N and R pages with a revision bar, its horizontal offset from the left margin must be l=-0.38 cm (tolerance +/- 0.10 cm).

CUSTOM_REVISION_BAR_MODIFIED_PAGE.name: Revision bar present on modified pages
CUSTOM_REVISION_BAR_MODIFIED_PAGE.description: Every page declared R in Highlights must have at least one black revision bar.

CUSTOM_REVISION_BAR_NEW_PAGE.name: Full-height revision bar on new pages
CUSTOM_REVISION_BAR_NEW_PAGE.description: Every page declared N in Highlights must have a nearly full-height black revision bar from the top of the content to the footer.

CUSTOM_REVISION_FOOTER_DATE.name: Footer date consistent with Highlights and the LEP
CUSTOM_REVISION_FOOTER_DATE.description: The footer must show the mapped revision date for a revised or new page, and the date declared in the list of effective pages for an unchanged page.

CUSTOM_REVISION_HIGHLIGHTS_STATUS.name: Highlights designation consistent with the LEP and footer
CUSTOM_REVISION_HIGHLIGHTS_STATUS.description: Highlights Designation must be R, N, U, or D. The designation must agree with the LEP and footer; a D page must no longer appear in the current LEP or document. When the previous PDF is provided, N must be absent from its LEP, while R, U, and D must be present.

CUSTOM_REVISION_LEP_BLANK_STAR.name: LEP star on Blank pages based on the odd page New status
CUSTOM_REVISION_LEP_BLANK_STAR.description: A Blank entry in the LEP has a star only when the odd page in its pair is declared N (New) in Highlights. A page declared R (Modify), unchanged, or without an N status must not have a star.

CUSTOM_REVISION_LEP_DATE.name: LEP date consistent with the page status
CUSTOM_REVISION_LEP_DATE.description: For a revised or new page, the list of effective pages date must equal the mapped revision date and remain the latest known issue date for an unchanged page.

CUSTOM_REVISION_LEP_STAR.name: Revised or new page marked with a star in the LEP
CUSTOM_REVISION_LEP_STAR.description: Every page declared revised (R) or new (N) in Highlights must have a star after its date in the list of effective pages.

CUSTOM_REVISION_MODIFIED_PAGE_ABSENT.name: Page declared revised is present in the document
CUSTOM_REVISION_MODIFIED_PAGE_ABSENT.description: Every page declared revised or new in Highlights must exist in the document and be identified in its footer.

CUSTOM_REVISION_PAGE_NOT_IN_LEP.name: Document page listed in the list of effective pages
CUSTOM_REVISION_PAGE_NOT_IN_LEP.description: Every page in the document must appear in the list of effective pages.

CUSTOM_REVISION_UNDECLARED_PAGE.name: Page dated with the current revision declared modified
CUSTOM_REVISION_UNDECLARED_PAGE.description: A page carrying the current revision date must be declared modified in Highlights (R or N) and marked with a star in the LEP.

CUSTOM_REVISION_UNDECLARED_STAR.name: LEP star justified by an R or N status in Highlights
CUSTOM_REVISION_UNDECLARED_STAR.description: A star in the list of effective pages marks a modified page; that page must be declared R or N in Highlights.

CUSTOM_ROR_INSERTION_DATE.name: Record of Revisions insertion date matches the revision date
CUSTOM_ROR_INSERTION_DATE.description: In the Record of Revisions, the insertion date must use the revision month when the revision day is below 15, otherwise the following month.

CUSTOM_ROR_REVISION_DATE.name: Record of Revisions date matches the Highlights
CUSTOM_ROR_REVISION_DATE.description: The current revision date in the Record of Revisions must match the revision date used by the Highlights.

CUSTOM_SENTENCE_PUNCTUATION.name: Required punctuation for sentences and enumerations
CUSTOM_SENTENCE_PUNCTUATION.description: On modified pages, every sentence must end with a full stop and every enumeration must follow its most common terminal mark (full stop, semicolon, comma, or no mark). Ties use commas for intermediate items and a full stop for the last.

CUSTOM_STORAGE_NOTE.name: Required introduction and categories in STORAGE notes
CUSTOM_STORAGE_NOTE.description: Each STORAGE page must start its NOTE with the expected operational introduction and contain the Pressure, Relative humidity, and Temperature categories with their reference values.

CUSTOM_TEMPERATURE_FAHRENHEIT.name: Temperature in deg. C must include its deg. F conversion
CUSTOM_TEMPERATURE_FAHRENHEIT.description: Every temperature expressed in deg. C must be followed by its numeric conversion in deg. F in parentheses.

CUSTOM_TEMPERATURE_RANGE_FORMAT.name: Temperature ranges formatted as X to X deg. C
CUSTOM_TEMPERATURE_RANGE_FORMAT.description: A Celsius temperature range must use X to X deg. C: the unit appears after the second value, with no C in the middle.

CUSTOM_TESTING_NOTE.name: Required introduction and categories in TESTING notes
CUSTOM_TESTING_NOTE.description: Each TESTING page must start its NOTE with the expected operational introduction and contain the Pressure, Relative humidity, and Temperature categories.

CUSTOM_THALES_LOGO_FONT_SIZE.name: THALES logo font size on non-TP1 pages
CUSTOM_THALES_LOGO_FONT_SIZE.description: The Thales T at the start of the page must use a 31 pt font outside TP1 pages.

CUSTOM_TITLE_PAGE_COPYRIGHT.name: Footer copyright matches the revision year
CUSTOM_TITLE_PAGE_COPYRIGHT.description: The footer of pages modified by the revision must contain the full reference THALES copyright text. Its start year must match the first issue year, and its end year the document revision year.

CUSTOM_TP1_FIRST_ISSUE_DATE.name: TP1 footer first issue date matches the mapping
CUSTOM_TP1_FIRST_ISSUE_DATE.description: Each TP1 page must contain 'First Issue: date' in its footer, with a date equal to the first issue date in the mapping.

CUSTOM_TP1_HEADER_DOCUMENT_TYPE.name: Document type in TP1 content
CUSTOM_TP1_HEADER_DOCUMENT_TYPE.description: Every TP1 page content must contain an allowed document type: OVERHAUL MANUAL, MAINTENANCE MANUAL, COMPONENT MAINTENANCE MANUAL, ABBREVIATED COMPONENT MAINTENANCE MANUAL, OPERATING MANUAL, ILLUSTRATED PARTS CATALOG, COMPONENT MAINTENANCE PARTS LIST, or OPERATING MANUAL PARTS LIST.

CUSTOM_TP1_PNR_PAGE_VALUE.name: PNR number in the TP1 page matches the mapping
CUSTOM_TP1_PNR_PAGE_VALUE.description: Every PNR value in the body of a TP1 page must match one of the document mapping values.

CUSTOM_TP1_REVISION_BAR_FOOTER.name: Revision bar across the TP1 footer
CUSTOM_TP1_REVISION_BAR_FOOTER.description: On TP 1 declared R, a black revision bar must run through the footer from Revision, covering First Issue, to below the final copyright line.

CUSTOM_TP1_REVISION_NUMBER.name: TP1 footer revision number matches the mapping
CUSTOM_TP1_REVISION_NUMBER.description: Each TP1 page must contain 'Revision No. 0X' above 'First Issue' in its footer, with 0X equal to the revision number in the mapping. The checklist also requires the previous revision number plus 1; this rule does not calculate that progression.

CUSTOM_TP1_THALES_ADDRESS.name: Exact THALES address on TP1 pages
CUSTOM_TP1_THALES_ADDRESS.description: Every page identified as TP1 must contain the exact reference THALES address.

CUSTOM_TP1_THALES_LOGO_FONT_SIZE.name: THALES logo font size on TP1 pages
CUSTOM_TP1_THALES_LOGO_FONT_SIZE.description: The Thales T at the start of a TP1 page must use a 36 pt font.

CUSTOM_TP2_IMPORTANT_NOTICE.name: TP2 Important Notice matches the ATA100 template
CUSTOM_TP2_IMPORTANT_NOTICE.description: The IMPORTANT NOTICE block on TP2 must exactly match the ATA100 template, apart from line-break and space differences.

CUSTOM_TP2_REVISION_BAR_BODY_ONLY.name: TP2 revision bar limited to the body area
CUSTOM_TP2_REVISION_BAR_BODY_ONLY.description: On a TP2 page declared R, the revision bar must stay in the body area, outside the header and footer. It may align with an empty paragraph.

CUSTOM_VENDOR_CODE_LIST_REFERENCE.name: THALES vendor code and address
CUSTOM_VENDOR_CODE_LIST_REFERENCE.description: Only the THALES entry in vendor code tables is validated: code VF9111 must match the official THALES AVS FRANCE SAS address at 75-77 AV MARCEL DASSAULT, CAMPUS THALES BORDEAUX, 33700 MERIGNAC, FRANCE. Other vendors are ignored.

STE_FIRST_PERSON.name: First person forbidden
STE_FIRST_PERSON.description: ASD-STE100 §3.5 forbids the first person in maintenance manuals.

STE_LONG_SENTENCE.name: Sentence too long
STE_LONG_SENTENCE.description: ASD-STE100 §6.4: maximum 20 words per procedural sentence and 25 words per descriptive sentence.

STE_NO_MAYBE.name: Vague modal
STE_NO_MAYBE.description: ASD-STE100 §6 forbids ambiguous modals in procedures.

STE_PASSIVE_VOICE.name: Passive voice
STE_PASSIVE_VOICE.description: ASD-STE100 §3.4 requires the active voice in procedures.

STE_PROCEDURAL_GERUND.name: Gerund at the start of a procedure
STE_PROCEDURAL_GERUND.description: ASD-STE100 §3.3 requires the imperative form for procedures.

STE_VOCAB_NON_APPROVED.name: Unapproved vocabulary
STE_VOCAB_NON_APPROVED.description: STE100 flags common synonyms that should be avoided.
